name: Shinobu
source:
Job: Dorm Master
A daydreaming gentle soul. He's easily distracted by squirrels and chases after butterflies. Although Ren doesn't show him brotherly love, he did help Shinobu get this job. That said, Shinobu can't bring himself to think badly of his bro, let alone stand up to him. Despite his soft nature, he gets very Mr. Hyde if Gou's Beta scene wears off Aki. Beware!
translation:
Job: Dorm Master
A daydreaming gentle soul. He's easily distracted by squirrels and chases after butterflies. Although Ren doesn't show him brotherly love, he did help Shinobu get this job. That said, Shinobu can't bring himself to think badly of his bro, let alone stand up to him. Despite his soft nature, he gets very Mr. Hyde if Gou's Beta scene wears off Aki. Beware!
